title: Harp's Haven Main House | Royal Destinations
meta_description: 30A Pet Friendly Rental home located in sought after Rosemary Beach complete with a private pool in the courtyard- Harp's Haven by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Harp's Haven Main House by Royal Destinations Location: Rosemary Beach Address: 52 Scout Lane Details: Located in sought after Rosemary Beach, Harp's Haven is sure to be your favorite home away from home on 30A! Featuring a private courtyard pool, great outdoor space complete with beautiful porches, and impeccable interior decor, Harp's Haven is one of a kind. Harp's Haven welcomes you with a generous front porch offering a cozy entertaining space with a swing bed and rocking chairs. Step inside to experience this custom-designed home offering 3,600 square feet with 6 bedrooms and 6 1/2 baths. A covered outdoor patio is perfectly positioned overlooking the pool and courtyard featuring a fireplace and smart TV for outdoor living. The courtyard features Dominican shell stone pavers and a 14' x 7' pool with a waterfall feature and optional pool heater. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Private Courtyard Pool *Pool heat is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional $330 (pre-tax) *The pool heater does require 24 hours to reach the optimal temperature of 83-85 degrees. *Please contact Reservations to add this feature prior to your stay. - Pet Friendly with approval *Additional Fee Applicable $350 each (pre-tax) *Please contact Reservations for approval prior to your stay. - 6 Adult Bikes - Keurig and Regular Coffee Pot - Spacious Porches Throughout - Single Car Garage Available to Guests - Fully Fenced In Courtyard Area Rosemary Beach Neighborhood Highlights: -Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks -A short bike ride to Alys and Seacrest Beach -An Abundance of Green Spaces -4 Swimming Pools -Tennis Facility (Fees Applicable) -Fitness Center (Fees Applicable) -Bike Community -Playground Sleeping Arrangements (14): Main Home: First Floor: -Bedroom 1 - King Master Suite, Private Bath (Shower) -Kitchen, Great Room, Half Bath, Laundry -Lanai and Private Heated Pool Second Floor: -Bedroom 2 - King Master Suite, Private Bath (Shower), Porch and Fireplace -Bedroom 3 - King Suite Private Bath (Shower), Private Balcony -Bedroom 4 - King Suite, Private Bath (Tub/Shower Combo), Balcony -Laundry Third Floor: -Bedroom 5 – King Master, Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower), Private Balcony -Bedroom 6 - Bunk Room (2 Twin/Twin 1 Twin) Private Bath (Shower) Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *Smart TVs are available throughout the home, allowing you to log in to your personal streaming services. YouTubeTV is available. Home Sweet Home: A Note From The Homeowner- For over a decade, our family has enjoyed 30A, from WaterColor to Seacrest, but Rosemary Beach holds a special place in our hearts. Its welcoming atmosphere, stunning beaches, and relaxed vibe invite you to slow down and enjoy life. We love being able to walk to great restaurants and shops. We designed our home as a true retreat, a place to reconnect, relax, and make lasting memories. With plenty of space for everyone, it’s a perfect blend of comfort and privacy, so no one ever feels cramped. Whether recharging or spending time together, we hope you find it as special as we do.
